description: Snipe-IT: IT asset management for hardware, licenses, accessories and consumables, with audits and a REST API, the admin and APP_KEY generated at install and a bundled MariaDB. Hardened by QuenchWorks: nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Koel: a personal music streaming server with a web player, playlists, podcasts and a Subsonic-compatible API, with the admin and APP_KEY generated at install and the library on a volume. Hardened by QuenchWorks: nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Lychee: photo management with albums, sharing, smart albums, EXIF and map views and a REST API, with the admin and APP_KEY generated at install and the photos on a volume. Hardened by QuenchWorks: nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
